players.product: DCI transport and optical amplifier modules (800G CFP2) and datacom transceivers; silicon-waveguide optical circuit switch (OCS) at sample stage

quarterly_data.quarter: Wuxi Taclink Optoelectronics results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual collective (05-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company (2025 annual collective results briefing, also its Q1 2026 briefing; pre-collected answers): it expects high-speed datacom optical modules led by 1.6T to see supply and demand ramp quickly together in 2026; as its Thailand base releases capacity its high-speed datacom modules will ramp gradually and DCI products keep growing fast, and it is confident of fast revenue growth in 2026. In Q1 2026 the overseas revenue share rose YoY, access and data business revenue rose clearly both YoY and QoQ, the gross-profit contribution of DCI improved as DCI products ramped, and profitability is gradually improving through product-mix optimisation and lean management.

quarterly_data.quarter: Wuxi Taclink Optoelectronics results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual collective (05-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company (2025 annual collective results briefing, pre-collected answers): 800G datacom modules have small-batch orders; 1.6T datacom modules have completed product development on three routes (EML, silicon photonics and TFLN) and customer sampling and certification are being pushed; 800G DCI cards completed sample development and verification and 1.6T cards are in pre-research. The Thailand plant started trial production in April 2026 and is expected to enter formal production in June; it mainly serves overseas markets with optical amplifiers, optical modules and optical transmission subsystems. The global footprint comprises an overseas headquarters in Singapore, R&D in Canada, manufacturing in Thailand and sales offices in Germany and Japan; the share of core devices it designs and makes itself is rising gradually. Chairman and general manager Qu Jianping said the optical-communication device segment is in a high-growth cycle but split: datacom and AI-compute demand for data-center interconnect and high-speed modules stays strong on rising global AI capex and the 800G/1.6T upgrade, while telecom demand is relatively flat and expected to recover gradually with 5G-A and 50G PON upgrades; the company keeps multiple qualified suppliers for core materials.

quarterly_data.quarter: Wuxi Taclink Optoelectronics results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual collective (05-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company (2025 annual collective results briefing, pre-collected answer): its OCS product is still at sample-order delivery and technical validation; because OCS needs large investment and the product is at an early stage, the company has not included OCS products in its financial budgets and performance plans for the next two to three years. Chairman and general manager Qu Jianping said sample development of the 64x64-port OCS is progressing as expected.
